root_cause.text: The mtk_jpeg_release function frees the context structure without first synchronously cancelling pending or running work items (ctx->jpeg_work), allowing the workqueue callback to access freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states that mtk_jpeg_release() frees the context structure without cancelling ctx->jpeg_work, and the patch diff shows the addition of cancel_work_sync(&ctx->jpeg_work); at the beginning of the release function to prevent the race.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The mtk_jpeg_release function frees the context structure without first synchronously cancelling pending or running work items (ctx->jpeg_work), allowing the workqueue callback to access freed memory.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes a race condition during file closure by synchronizing and cancelling pending JPEG work before releasing context resources.
intent_record.what: Inserted a call to cancel_work_sync(&ctx->jpeg_work) at the beginning of the mtk_jpeg_release function body.
intent_record.how: Ensures any pending or currently executing JPEG processing work is stopped and waited upon before the function proceeds to acquire locks and free resources, preventing concurrent access to freed memory.

grouping_result.intent: Fixes a race condition during file closure by synchronizing and cancelling pending JPEG work before releasing context resources.

relevance_review.reason: The group's core intent explicitly describes fixing the race condition by synchronizing and cancelling pending work before releasing context resources, which directly addresses the root cause of freeing memory while work items are still active.
